notes.title: Playtest Grant Waves — Today 22:00 & 06:00 (GMT+3)
notes.content:
[b]Playtest is live![/b] We’re granting access in [b]two waves[/b] today.

[hr]
[b]⏰ Schedule[/b]
• [b]Wave 1:[/b] 25 Aug, 22:00 (GMT+3)
• [b]Wave 2:[/b] 26 Aug, 06:00 (GMT+3)
[i]If you’re not picked in Wave 1, you’re still eligible for Wave 2.[/i]

[hr]
[b]🪄 How to join[/b]

Open the store page below.

Click [b]“Request Access”[/b] on the Playtest.

At wave time, install from your [b]Library[/b].

[hr]
[b]🎯 Why now?[/b]
• Your pet [b]lives on your desktop[/b]—it digs while you work.
• [b]No timers[/b]; quick care moments to [b]feed, pet & heal[/b].
• QoL: no drift, small-screen clicks fixed, [i]Adopt[/i] panel first.

[hr]
Join here → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875660/Cozy_Pet_Life_Idle/
